description: We are seeking a Junior Analyst to join our Investment Banking division in London. The successful candidate will support deal execution across M&A and capital markets transactions, build and maintain financial models, and prepare client-facing materials. This is a demanding, fast-paced role suited to a highly analytical graduate with strong attention to detail.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline
Strong financial modelling skills including DCF, LBO and comparable company analysis
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Proficiency in Python or SQL for data analysis
Prior internship experience in investment banking or financial services
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple deadlines
